note: Read by the 7:30 AM ET Postiz task (TikTok + YouTube) and the matchday full-time one-shot before they post. Set a key to false to stop that platform; a missing key means true. The 6:45 task always commits the post files regardless. 'debate_autopost' is read by the weekly THE DEBATE task before it posts.
note_links: 'links_autopost' (missing = on) stops the 7:43 AM Facebook + Bluesky post altogether. 'video_on_facebook_bluesky' (missing = on): false sends the plain link post there, not the day's video. 'question_autopost' (missing = on) stops the 12:07 PM question. 'fulltime_on_facebook_bluesky' (missing = on): false keeps the matchday full-time card off Facebook and Bluesky (TikTok and YouTube are not affected). 'debate_on_facebook_bluesky' (missing = on): false keeps the Wednesday DEBATE short off Facebook and Bluesky (TikTok and YouTube are not affected).
